Fig214 a/b references and fig215 a/b containment definitions agree with the current media. Unrelated fig216-218 content remains bound as provenance but was not opened or depicted in these figures.

modern_additions: Modern a/b panel tokens follow the approved text.
Continuation arrowheads express approved ray semantics; they do not identify the source terminal printing.
Neutral thinner support traces distinguish carriers from rays without claiming a source solid/dashed identity.
Coordinates, trace extents, label spacing and hidden B/D transport-anchor alignment are layout choices, not numerical source givens.

Visible geometry and text use semantic CSS variables. Hidden renderer placeholder paths have display none and no instructional content; they are not visible theme colors or cultural marks.
